title: Kediyiz Haklıyız
author: Elif Bahar
description: In a fantastical city where animals, humans, plants, and even musical instruments live together, Pelin’s beloved cat Şaşkın and his family are suddenly evicted from their apartment building. Pelin and her friends join forces to help. Following Şaşkın’s idea, they prepare colorful banners and protest in front of the building. A vibrant and humorous story about animal rights, coexistence, creativity, courage, and respect for every living being.
